description.value:
Lightning Cutter. Kakashi's signature refinement of Chidori. Where the original is a charge, Raikiri is a controlled, two-bladed strike that can curve mid-air.

Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet (no Stride required). On a hit, the target takes 7d12 slashing electricity damage. If your Strike result equals or beats the target's AC by 10 or more, the lightning continues through and arcs to a second creature within 10 feet of the first; that creature takes 4d12 slashing electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

Raikiri does not commit you to a straight-line motion the way Chidori does.

Heightened (+1) Both damages increase by 1d12.
